a.lede: Elon Musk defended the company's decision to stop making the Cybertruck, which will go out of production in around eight months.
a.title: Musk says Tesla will refund some Cybertruck deposits, defends decision to end production

b.title: Tesla will stop making the Cybertruck in 2027
